# mcdp_lib function index (generated by tools/gen_library_index.py; do not edit)

Search this before writing a new function. Call as `function mcdp_lib:<path> {args}` (macro) or set the
listed inputs first. Full contract (outputs, side effects, context, example) is in each file's header.
Conventions: inputs `mcdp_lib:in` storage / `mcdp_lib.in` scores, outputs `mcdp_lib:out` / `#result mcdp_lib.out`
and the function's return value; `fast` = no macro (safe per tick); never call `_internal/` functions.

## (root)
- `mcdp_lib:noop` `(no macro args)` **fast** - Does nothing; pass it where a callback is required but none is wanted.

## debug
- `mcdp_lib:debug/error` `{msg}` - debug/log at level 1 (error).
- `mcdp_lib:debug/info` `{msg}` - debug/log at level 3 (info).
- `mcdp_lib:debug/log` `{level, msg}` - Log a message if level <= the current debug level: chat to players tagged mcdp_lib.debug, and `say` to the server log when mcdp_lib:config debug_console is 1b.
- `mcdp_lib:debug/set_level` `{level}` - Choose which log messages are shown: 0 off, 1 error, 2 warn, 3 info, 4 trace.
- `mcdp_lib:debug/trace` `{msg}` - debug/log at level 4 (trace/debug).
- `mcdp_lib:debug/warn` `{msg}` - debug/log at level 2 (warn).
- `mcdp_lib:debug/watch` `(no macro args)` **fast** - Toggle chat logging for @s (adds or removes tag mcdp_lib.debug).

## flow
- `mcdp_lib:flow/after` `{function, ticks}` - Call a function after N ticks (schedule ... append: calling twice runs it twice).
- `mcdp_lib:flow/after_as` `{function, ticks}` - Call a function N ticks later as/at @s (skipped if @s is gone by then).
- `mcdp_lib:flow/break` `(no macro args)` **fast** - Inside a flow/repeat callback: stop the innermost repeat after the current call.
- `mcdp_lib:flow/repeat` `{function, times}` - Call a function N times in a row (capped by mcdp_lib:config max_repeat, default 1000); nesting is safe.

## fsm
- `mcdp_lib:fsm/define` `{machine}` - Create a state machine from mcdp_lib:in fsm and enter its initial state (runs its enter function).
- `mcdp_lib:fsm/get` `{machine}` - Read the current state name of a machine.
- `mcdp_lib:fsm/is` `{machine, state}` - Test whether a machine is in a given state.
- `mcdp_lib:fsm/set` `{machine, state}` - Transition to a state: runs the current state's exit, then the new state's enter.
- `mcdp_lib:fsm/tick` `{machine}` - Run the current state's tick function (call it from your own tick function).

## item
- `mcdp_lib:item/clear` `{count, item, targets}` - Remove up to count items matching an item predicate (count 0 = only count them).
- `mcdp_lib:item/clear_custom` `{id, targets}` - Remove every item tagged custom_data {mcdp_id:"<id>"} from players.
- `mcdp_lib:item/custom` `{count, id, item, name, targets}` - Give a custom-named item tagged with custom_data {mcdp_id:"<id>"} so it can be detected later.
- `mcdp_lib:item/custom_to_slot` `{count, id, item, name, slot}` - Like item/custom but puts the item into a slot of @s (works on mobs and armor stands too).
- `mcdp_lib:item/give` `{count, item, targets}` - Give an item stack given as item syntax, e.g. "minecraft:stick[unbreakable={}]".
- `mcdp_lib:item/give_from_storage` `(no macro args)` **fast** - Drop the item compound in mcdp_lib:in item ({id,count,components}) at the current position with no pickup delay (a player there picks it up next tick).
- `mcdp_lib:item/has_custom` `{id, slots}` - Count stacks in @s's slots that carry custom_data {mcdp_id:"<id>"}.
- `mcdp_lib:item/kit` `{name}` - Hand out a kit stored in mcdp_lib:config kits.<name>: entries {item,count} are given, entries {slot,item,count} replace that slot.
- `mcdp_lib:item/set_slot_from_storage` `{slot}` - Put the item compound in mcdp_lib:in item into a slot of @s, keeping every component exactly.

## list
- `mcdp_lib:list/dequeue` `{path, storage}` - Remove and return the first element (queue pop; pair with list/push).
- `mcdp_lib:list/find` `{path, storage}` - Index of the first element exactly equal (same NBT type and value) to mcdp_lib:in value.
- `mcdp_lib:list/foreach` `{function, path, storage}` - Call a function once per element of a storage list (iterates a copy; nested foreach is safe).
- `mcdp_lib:list/get` `{index, path, storage}` - Copy the element at an index (negative counts from the end).
- `mcdp_lib:list/insert` `{index, path, storage}` - Insert a value before an index (0 = front; creates the list if missing).
- `mcdp_lib:list/pop` `{path, storage}` - Remove and return the last element (stack pop).
- `mcdp_lib:list/push` `{path, storage}` - Append a value to a storage list (creates the list if missing). Also "enqueue".
- `mcdp_lib:list/remove` `{index, path, storage}` - Remove the element at an index (negative counts from the end).
- `mcdp_lib:list/size` `{path, storage}` - Length of a storage list (0 if missing).

## math
- `mcdp_lib:math/abs` `(no macro args)` **fast** - Absolute value of #value.
- `mcdp_lib:math/clamp` `(no macro args)` **fast** - Clamp #value to [#min, #max] without macros (hot-path safe).
- `mcdp_lib:math/div` `(no macro args)` **fast** - Safe floor division #a / #b (rounds toward -infinity like the scoreboard: -7/2 = -4).
- `mcdp_lib:math/max` `(no macro args)` **fast** - Larger of #a and #b.
- `mcdp_lib:math/min` `(no macro args)` **fast** - Smaller of #a and #b.
- `mcdp_lib:math/mod` `(no macro args)` **fast** - Safe modulo #a % #b (sign follows #b: -7 % 2 = 1).

## msg
- `mcdp_lib:msg/actionbar` `{targets}` - Show the text component in mcdp_lib:in text on the action bar.
- `mcdp_lib:msg/broadcast` `(no macro args)` **fast** - Send the text component in mcdp_lib:in text to every player.
- `mcdp_lib:msg/countdown` `{callback, display, label, name, seconds, targets}` - Show "<label><seconds left>" once per second, then call a function when it reaches 0.
- `mcdp_lib:msg/countdown_cancel` `{name}` - Stop a countdown without calling its callback.
- `mcdp_lib:msg/tell` `{targets}` - Send the text component stored in mcdp_lib:in text to the selected players.
- `mcdp_lib:msg/title` `{fade_in, fade_out, stay, targets}` - Show a title (and optional subtitle) from storage with custom fade times.

## player
- `mcdp_lib:player/count` `{selector}` - Count entities/players matching a selector (e.g. "@a[team=red]", "@a[tag=alive]").
- `mcdp_lib:player/forget` `(no macro args)` - Delete everything saved for @s by the save_* functions.
- `mcdp_lib:player/random` `{selector, tag}` - Give a tag to exactly one random entity matching a selector (removes the tag from everyone else first).
- `mcdp_lib:player/restore_gamemode` `(no macro args)` - Restore the game mode saved by save_gamemode.
- `mcdp_lib:player/restore_inventory` `(no macro args)` - Replace @s's items with the ones saved by save_inventory (exact components kept).
- `mcdp_lib:player/restore_position` `(no macro args)` - Teleport @s back to the position saved by save_position (custom dimensions restore only for players).
- `mcdp_lib:player/restore_state` `(no macro args)` - restore_inventory + restore_gamemode + restore_position in one call.
- `mcdp_lib:player/save_gamemode` `(no macro args)` - Remember a player's game mode.
- `mcdp_lib:player/save_inventory` `(no macro args)` - Remember @s's items: player Inventory (slots 0-35) and equipment (armor, hands, body, saddle).
- `mcdp_lib:player/save_position` `(no macro args)` - Remember @s's position, rotation and dimension (keyed by UUID; works for any entity).
- `mcdp_lib:player/save_state` `(no macro args)` - save_position + save_gamemode + save_inventory in one call.
- `mcdp_lib:player/tag_add` `{selector, tag}` - Add a tag to every entity matching a selector.
- `mcdp_lib:player/tag_only` `{selector, tag}` - Make a tag exclusive: remove it from all entities, then add it to the selector's matches.
- `mcdp_lib:player/tag_remove` `{selector, tag}` - Remove a tag from every entity matching a selector.
- `mcdp_lib:player/uid` `(no macro args)` **fast** - Unique, stable integer id for @s (assigned on first call; works for any entity).

## random
- `mcdp_lib:random/chance` `{percent}` - Succeed with the given probability in percent.
- `mcdp_lib:random/int` `{max, min}` - Uniform random integer in [min, max] (inclusive).
- `mcdp_lib:random/int_fast` `(no macro args)` **fast** - Random integer in [#min, #max] without macros (modulo of a 31-bit roll; bias is negligible).
- `mcdp_lib:random/pick` `{path, storage}` - Copy one uniformly random element of a storage list.
- `mcdp_lib:random/pick_n` `{n, path, storage}` - Pick n distinct elements (by position) of a storage list in random order.
- `mcdp_lib:random/shuffle` `{path, storage}` - Shuffle a storage list in place (uniform: repeatedly moves a random remaining element).
- `mcdp_lib:random/weighted` `{path, storage}` - Weighted random pick from a list of {weight:int>=0, value:any}.

## rules
- `mcdp_lib:rules/apply` `{targets}` - Apply a rules struct from mcdp_lib:in rules; remembers previous values so rules/revert can undo it. Any key may be omitted.
- `mcdp_lib:rules/apply_self` `(no macro args)` - Apply the per-entity part of the active rules (game mode, block_break, effects) to @s, e.g. for players who join or respawn later.
- `mcdp_lib:rules/revert` `(no macro args)` - Undo rules/apply: restore the previous gamerule values, game modes, attribute and effects.

## score
- `mcdp_lib:score/add` `{objective, target, value}` - Add a (possibly negative) amount to a score; an unset score counts as 0.
- `mcdp_lib:score/clamp` `{max, min, objective, target}` - Clamp a score in place to [min, max].
- `mcdp_lib:score/compare` `{a, a_objective, b, b_objective, op}` - Compare two scores with <, <=, =, >=, >.
- `mcdp_lib:score/counter_global` `{amount, objective}` - Global counter: add amount to the fake player #global, creating the objective if needed.
- `mcdp_lib:score/counter_self` `{amount, objective}` - Per-entity counter: add amount to @s on a dummy objective, creating the objective if needed.
- `mcdp_lib:score/ensure` `{criteria, name}` - Create a scoreboard objective if it does not exist yet (no-op if it does).
- `mcdp_lib:score/from_storage` `{objective, path, scale, storage, target}` - Copy a numeric storage value into a score, multiplied by scale and truncated to int.
- `mcdp_lib:score/matches` `{objective, range, target}` - Test a score against a range such as "1..5", "..0" or "7".
- `mcdp_lib:score/reset` `{objective, target}` - Remove a score (target may be a selector, or * for every holder).
- `mcdp_lib:score/set` `{objective, target, value}` - Set a score.
- `mcdp_lib:score/to_storage` `{objective, path, storage, target}` - Copy a score into storage as an int.

## team
- `mcdp_lib:team/count` `{name}` - Number of loaded entities (players included) on a team.
- `mcdp_lib:team/empty` `{name}` - Remove all members from a team (the team stays).
- `mcdp_lib:team/join` `{name, selector}` - Put every entity matching a selector on a team.
- `mcdp_lib:team/leave` `{selector}` - Remove every entity matching a selector from its team.
- `mcdp_lib:team/remove` `{name}` - Delete a team.
- `mcdp_lib:team/setup` `{collision, color, friendly_fire, name, nametag}` - Create (or update) a team with color, friendly fire, collision and name tag rules.

## timer
- `mcdp_lib:timer/create` `{callback, name}` - Register a countdown timer/cooldown (objective <name>) ticked by the library every game tick.
- `mcdp_lib:timer/pause` `{name}` - Pause every instance of a registered timer (entities and #global).
- `mcdp_lib:timer/pause_self` `{name}` - Pause only @s's instance of a timer.
- `mcdp_lib:timer/ready` `{name}` - Cooldown check: 1 if @s has no running timer <name>, else 0.
- `mcdp_lib:timer/remaining` `{name}` - Ticks left on @s's timer (0 if not running).
- `mcdp_lib:timer/remaining_global` `{name}` - Ticks left on the global timer (0 if not running).
- `mcdp_lib:timer/resume` `{name}` - Resume a timer paused with mcdp_lib:timer/pause.
- `mcdp_lib:timer/resume_self` `{name}` - Resume @s's instance of a timer paused with pause_self.
- `mcdp_lib:timer/start` `{name, ticks}` - Start (or restart) a registered timer on @s; the callback fires after <ticks> game ticks.
- `mcdp_lib:timer/start_global` `{name, ticks}` - Start (or restart) the global instance of a registered timer (fake player #global).
- `mcdp_lib:timer/stop` `{name}` - Cancel @s's timer without running the callback (also clears its pause).
- `mcdp_lib:timer/stop_global` `{name}` - Cancel the global timer without running the callback.

## world
- `mcdp_lib:world/clone` `{mode, x, x1, x2, y, y1, y2, z, z1, z2}` - Copy a box so its lowest corner lands on (x,y,z).
- `mcdp_lib:world/fill` `{block, mode, x1, x2, y1, y2, z1, z2}` - Fill a box with a block (at most max_block_modifications = 32768 blocks per call by default).
- `mcdp_lib:world/fill_spread` `{block, callback, layers, x1, x2, y1, y2, z1, z2}` - Queue a big fill that runs <layers> horizontal layers per game tick (bottom to top), then calls a function.
- `mcdp_lib:world/place_template` `{template, x, y, z}` - Place a structure template (data/<ns>/structure/<path>.nbt) at a position.
- `mcdp_lib:world/safe_spawn` `{x, z}` - Find the standing spot on top of column (x, z) and check it is not over a hazard (#mcdp_lib:unsafe_ground: lava, water, fire, cactus...).
- `mcdp_lib:world/safe_spawn_tp` `{x, z}` - Teleport @s on top of column (x, z) if that spot is safe (see world/safe_spawn).
- `mcdp_lib:world/setblock` `{block, x, y, z}` - Place one block.
- `mcdp_lib:world/tp` `{dimension, x, y, z}` - Teleport @s to coordinates in a dimension.
- `mcdp_lib:world/tp_stored` `{path, storage}` - Teleport @s to a location compound {x,y,z,dimension} kept in storage (e.g. a map's spawn list entry).
